title: MZ RPG Maker MZ How to hide item quantities

posts.author: DiscoReunion
posts.body:
Hello !
Is there a way to hide item quantities in menu in MZ ?
I use both item and key item for my game, which are two separate catergories. The key item doesn't have quantities so that's perfect, but I didn't find a way to hide the item quantities (the only thing I found during my research was a plugin for MV).
